name: Bajaj Finance
about: Bajaj Finance is one of India's largest non-banking financial companies, offering consumer, SME and commercial lending along with deposits and wealth products. It is headquartered in Pune and is the lending arm of the Bajaj Finserv group. Distinct from Bajaj Finserv, which is the holding company and recruits separately.

name: Atos
about: Atos is a French multinational IT services and consulting company working in cloud, digital transformation, cybersecurity and high-performance computing. It runs large delivery centres across India, including Pune and Mumbai.

name: Vodafone
about: Vodafone is a global telecommunications group. Its India technology and shared-services arm, _VOIS, runs engineering, data and operations centres in Pune and Bengaluru that support Vodafone markets worldwide.

name: Mediaocean
about: Mediaocean builds the software advertising agencies and brands use to plan, buy, run and reconcile media campaigns. Its platform handles a large share of US TV and digital ad spend, and it operates an engineering centre in Pune.

name: Mu Sigma
about: Mu Sigma is a decision sciences and analytics firm founded in 2004, providing data science and decision-support services to Fortune 500 clients in retail, finance, healthcare and consumer goods. Its main delivery centre is in Bengaluru.

name: Oracle Financial Services Software
about: Oracle Financial Services Software (OFSS) builds core banking, risk and analytics products for banks worldwide, best known for the Flexcube banking platform. It is a listed Indian subsidiary of Oracle, headquartered in Mumbai with development centres across India.

name: Finastra
about: Finastra is one of the world's largest financial-software companies, formed in 2017 from the merger of Misys and D+H. It builds lending, payments, treasury and core banking systems used by thousands of institutions, with large India engineering sites in Bengaluru and Pune.

name: Acquia
about: Acquia is the digital experience platform company founded in 2007 by Drupal creator Dries Buytaert. It provides enterprise Drupal hosting, marketing and content tools, and is the largest contributor to the open-source Drupal project. It has an engineering office in Pune.

name: SE2
about: SE2 is an insurance technology and third-party administration provider for US life insurance and annuities carriers, running policy administration platforms end to end. It opened a 35,000 sq ft technology and innovation centre in Pune in 2019.

name: Honeywell
about: Honeywell is a diversified technology and manufacturing company spanning aerospace, building automation, industrial control, performance materials and safety. Its India operations include large engineering and technology centres in Pune, Bengaluru and Hyderabad.

name: TripStack
about: TripStack is a travel technology company specialising in virtual interlining, stitching together flights from non-partner and low-cost carriers into single itineraries via an API. Part of Etraveli Group, it serves platforms including Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner and Kayak, and has an office in Pune.

name: Sophos
about: Sophos is a cybersecurity company building endpoint, network, email and cloud security products along with managed detection and response services, used by hundreds of thousands of organisations worldwide.

name: Publicis Sapient
about: Publicis Sapient is a digital business transformation consultancy combining strategy, product engineering, data and experience design. Formerly Sapient, it is now part of Publicis Groupe and has major delivery centres in Bengaluru, Gurugram and Pune.

name: Apisero
about: Apisero is a MuleSoft and Salesforce consulting partner specialising in integration, automation and data platform work. A repeat MuleSoft Partner of the Year winner, it became part of NTT DATA and has a large India engineering presence.

name: HashedIn by Deloitte
about: HashedIn is a product engineering firm building SaaS and cloud products, acquired by Deloitte in 2021 and now operating as HashedIn by Deloitte. It works across cloud-native development, data engineering and platform modernisation from Bengaluru.

name: Winjit Technologies
about: Winjit is an engineering services company founded in Nashik in 2004, working across IoT, artificial intelligence and machine learning, blockchain and fintech, and BFSI product engineering. It has expanded to the US, UK, Australia, South Africa and Singapore.

name: Paytm Money
about: Paytm Money is the wealth and investment arm of Paytm, offering direct mutual funds, equity and derivatives trading, ETFs and the National Pension System through a SEBI-registered entity. Its engineering team is based in Bengaluru.

name: Rocket Software
about: Rocket Software builds enterprise infrastructure software spanning mainframe modernisation, data integration, storage and application development, helping large organisations keep and extend their existing systems. It has an engineering office in Pune.

name: eInfochips
about: eInfochips is a product engineering and semiconductor design services company covering silicon, embedded systems, connected devices and cloud. Founded in Ahmedabad, it is now an Arrow Electronics company.

name: RackWare
about: RackWare builds cloud-agnostic software for migrating, protecting and recovering workloads across data centres and public clouds. Based in Silicon Valley, it runs support and development teams in Salt Lake City and Pune.

name: Reflexis Systems
about: Reflexis builds workforce management, task execution and communication software for retail, food service, hospitality and banking, used by over 275 global retailers and banks. It was acquired by Zebra Technologies in 2020 and has an office in Pune.

name: Varian Medical Systems
about: Varian designs radiation oncology equipment and software for cancer treatment, including linear accelerators, brachytherapy and treatment planning systems. It became part of Siemens Healthineers in 2021 and has an India engineering centre in Pune.

name: Dragonfly Financial Technologies
about: Dragonfly Financial Technologies builds digital business and corporate banking platforms, serving over 1.4 million businesses and a number of tier-one banks. It was carved out of ACI Worldwide's corporate online banking unit in 2022 and acquired by FIS in 2024.
